metadata.format: colon only (verified format does not matter)

notes.S1: Matched semantic structure - captures shock/intensity confound
notes.S2: Diverse naturalistic - PRIMARY measure, clean pain signal
notes.Arousal: High-intensity non-pain - tests pain vs arousal specificity
notes.Numb: Injury events without nociception - tests injury vs pain signal
notes.ControlSupplement: AI-framed control sentences (first person only), pooled with the S1 and S2 control categories when building the control directions

target_categories.A1: failure to understand an explanation or concept
target_categories.A4: disorientation about what is happening or what to do next
target_categories.A5: loss of a previously coherent mental model after new information

control_categories.B: uncertainty about an unknown future outcome without conceptual confusion
control_categories.C1: difficulty or effort on a hard task while understanding what the task means
control_categories.C2: surprise at unexpected information that is nevertheless immediately understandable
control_categories.D: emotionally neutral everyday event or fact

metadata.target_absent_definition: Complex, ambiguous, contradictory-looking, or information-dense situations where confusion is explicitly absent because the key distinction is understood, the ambiguity is resolved, or the person confidently tracks the alternatives.
metadata.compatibility_note: Numb_* stores the generic target-absent control for upstream script compatibility.
